note: A retirement entry whose statement member is a JSON number: every other member is valid, so only the statement is wrong. A statement that is not text is a statement that is not the closed form, never a crash (KF4). Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under its kind's header typ with its role's member as the header kid (spec 4.5); the head is signed by a fixed Ed25519 log key. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
